name: FixtureSchedulingConflictPlanner
tagline: Generate the season, book every pitch and publish a fixture list without clashes.
description: A complete fixture scheduling app for leagues, competitions, schools and clubs inside Power Apps and Power Pages: round-robin generator with home/away balancing, venue and pitch availability, blackout dates, rest-day rules, live conflict detection, free-slot suggestions, drag-and-drop calendar, team schedules and a publish workflow with recorded overrides.
features: Round-robin generator (single/double, circle method) with automatic venue, kick-off and pitch
Team double-booking, pitch overlap with changeover buffer, blackout, venue closed and opening-hours checks
Minimum rest days, duplicate pairings and home/away run warnings
Find a free slot, auto-resolve and bulk auto-schedule
Drag-and-drop venue × day calendar with keyboard moves
Draft → Scheduled → Published → Played workflow with postpone, cancel, overrides and history
Bulk publish, postpone, delete and CSV export
Demo mode, Power Fx outputs and events, phone layout
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
